title: Anchorage Digital Sets Up Asset Manager to Offer Bitcoin Yield to Clients
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Anchorage Digital Sets Up Asset Manager to Offer Bitcoin Yield to Clients Anchorage Digital is launching 61st Parallel Asset Management, a subsidiary expected to open by early December with a bitcoin-denominated fund that lets custody clients earn yield. This post Anchorage Digital Sets Up Asset Manager to Offer Bitcoin Yield to Clients first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
